title: Initiative runway & experimentation cadence for SLO-driven reliability
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Establish a repeatable initiative runway and experimentation cadence to operationalize SLOs across Redwood products.

Why now: As Dedicated and Private usage grows, we need a standard way to translate SLO targets into time-boxed initiatives, experiments, and rollout gates so teams can safely consume error budget and iterate on mitigations without manual coordination.

Scope:
- Define a standard 'runway' construct: time-boxed tranches (e.g., 6-week runway divided into three 2-week experiments) tied to OKR-level SLOs and error budget allocations.
- Create playbook patterns for experiments (A/B canary, traffic-shift, feature-flagged mitigation) with explicit gating conditions based on SLIs and error-budget spend rate.
- Deliver templates and dashboards: per-initiative Grafana/Grafana links, Confluence experiment plan template, and a single Initiative Tracker view.
- Integrate with rollout system so canaries auto-fallback when error budget burn exceeds X% in Y min.
- Define quality gates and acceptance criteria that map to OKRs (e.g., maintain p99 latency < 120ms, error rate < 0.1%).

Deliverables:
1) Initiative runway spec + decision log (Confluence)
2) Experiment templates and rollout gate configs (repo + Console runbooks)
3) Initiative Tracker dashboard (Console) that surfaces SLI trends and error budget runway guidance
4) One pilot initiative executed on a high-traffic API route with retro

Success metrics:
- Pilot completes with clear pass/fail by runway end and documented learnings.
- 80% of Reliability initiatives adopt the runway template within two cycles.
- Fewer ad-hoc rollbacks: 30% reduction in manual rollback incidents in the quarter.

Out-of-scope: platform-level SLO definition language; we will reuse existing SLI definitions stored in the SLI registry.
acceptance_criteria: Runway spec reviewed and approved by Reliability and Platform PMs
Experiment templates present in Confluence and linked from Initiative Tracker
Initiative Tracker surfaces error budget burn, projected runway, and owner contact for each initiative
Rollout system can trigger automated fallback when configured gate thresholds are exceeded
Pilot initiative run, retrospective captured, and template updated with learnings
